operating_notes.text: VECV April 2026 total sales volumes reached 7,318 units, up 6.9% YoY.
April 2026 total sales volumes reached 1,13,164 units, up 31% YoY; domestic 1,04,129 units (+37%), exports 9,035 units (-14%).
Company announced proposed greenfield expansion of 215.7 acres at Tada, Andhra Pradesh, with investment up to ₹2,500 Cr funded via internal accruals.
Royal Enfield's current manufacturing capacity is around 14.6 lakh motorcycles per year.
VECV increased its shareholding in VE Connected Solutions Private Limited from 51% to 74% for ₹1.10 Cr.
Eicher Motors approved investment of up to ₹750 Cr to acquire 50% equity in Volvo Financial Services (India) Private Limited.
Volvo Financial Services India had AUM of ₹1,825 Cr as of March 31, 2026; global VFS AUM was about USD 27.4 billion at end-CY2025 across about 40 markets.
The proposed 50:50 JV with Volvo Group will be the captive financing arm for VECV, EML and Volvo Group products in India.
Eicher Motors proposed a final dividend of ₹82 per share for FY26.
Volvo Financial Services India will form a 50:50 joint venture with Eicher Motors, with an investment of up to ₹750 crores.
Royal Enfield launched the Bullet 650 in India priced at ₹3,64,856 ex-showroom.
VECV May 2026: domestic 7,375 units (+9.1% YoY), exports 414 units (-17.2% YoY), Volvo Trucks & Buses 189 units (+32.2% YoY).
Royal Enfield announced plans for a greenfield manufacturing facility in Tada, Andhra Pradesh with an investment of approximately ₹2,500 crore.
Received a ₹1.64 Cr customs demand order including ₹0.82 Cr duty and ₹0.82 Cr penalty regarding a 2020 import shipment.
Royal Enfield dealer inventory at 10-12 days, plus 4-5 days in transit.
International business crossed ₹1,000 Cr revenue for the first time, 15.3% of Q1 revenue.
Accessories penetration rose to 87% from 35-40% initially.

timeline.summary: In April 2026, VE Commercial Vehicles reported a 6.9% YoY increase in total sales volume to 7,318 units.
In April 2026, Royal Enfield reported a 31% YoY increase in total sales volume to 1,13,164 units, driven by strong domestic demand and the launch of the Flying Flea C6 EV.
Eicher Motors secured a 215.7-acre land parcel in Tada, Andhra Pradesh for a proposed greenfield expansion requiring up to ₹2,500 Cr.
On 18 May 2026, Eicher Motors announced plans for a ₹2,500 Cr greenfield manufacturing facility in Tada, Andhra Pradesh.
On May 18, 2026, Eicher Motors announced that its subsidiary VECV received board approval to increase its stake in VE Connected Solutions from 51% to 74% for ₹1.11 Cr.
On May 21, 2026, Eicher Motors announced a board-approved investment of up to ₹750 Cr to acquire a 50% stake in Volvo Financial Services (India) as a joint venture.

On 21 May 2026, Eicher Motors' board approved an investment of up to ₹750 Cr for a 50% stake in a 50:50 JV with Volvo Group's Volvo Financial Services India, a captive financing arm for VECV, EML and Volvo products, subject to regulatory approvals.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹6,080.09 Cr (+16.0% YoY), net profit ₹1,519.95 Cr (+11.6% YoY).
On May 22, 2026, Eicher Motors reported record FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹23,408 Cr and PAT of ₹5,515 Cr, alongside a proposed final dividend of ₹82 per share.
On May 22, 2026, Eicher Motors released its Q4 and FY2026 investor presentation detailing operational performance and strategic growth.
Atul Sharma shared the conference call recording link for Q4 FY26 results discussion on May 22, 2026, via www.eicher.in/quarterly-results.
Eicher Motors reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹23,408 Cr, announced a ₹750 Cr vehicle financing JV with Volvo, and proposed a final dividend of ₹82 per share.
On May 28, 2026, Eicher Motors announced the launch of the Royal Enfield Bullet 650 in India at ₹3,64,856 ex-showroom.
On 1 June 2026, Eicher Motors reported VECV May 2026 sales of 7,978 units, up 7.8% YoY, with domestic volumes up 9.1% and exports down 17.2%.
Eicher Motors reported a 15% YoY increase in May 2026 total motorcycle sales to 1,03,231 units and announced a ₹2,500 Cr greenfield plant in Andhra Pradesh.
On June 4, 2026, Eicher Motors announced receipt of a ₹1.64 Cr customs demand and penalty order for a 2020 import shipment.
Eicher Motors Q1FY27 earnings call: revenue ₹6,632 Cr (+32% YoY), PAT ₹1,463 Cr (+21%), board approves ₹1,225 Cr Tada greenfield for 4.5 lakh units/year by FY30.
